records.issue_text: app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22 — The public members endpoint accepts an unbounded `limit`, allowing a caller to materialize and serialize an entire large group in one request.
records.rationale: The diff shows in app/controllers/groups_controller.rb lines 22-23 that `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` accepts user input without any upper bound validation. A caller could pass limit=1000000 to materialize and serialize an entire large group in one request, causing performance/DoS issues. This is a security/performance bug where user-controlled input is not properly bounded.

records.issue_text: spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb:115 — The automatic-group removal test invokes the action with PUT even though the new route only accepts DELETE, so it does not exercise the endpoint contract.
records.rationale: Looking at the diff, the routes.rb shows 'delete "members" => "groups#remove_member"' meaning the remove_member action requires DELETE method. However, in the test at line 115, the test uses 'xhr :put, :remove_member' instead of 'xhr :delete, :remove_member'. This is a real bug in the test - it's using the wrong HTTP method and won't properly test the endpoint as configured in the routes.
